data.name: Casilda
data.gender_notes: Casilda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Casilda is derived from the Latin word casus, meaning ‘event’ or ‘occurrence’, and ilda, meaning ‘battle’ or ‘strife’. This name signifies a pure, tender, and noble individual who has experienced or is involved in significant events and conflicts. The name Casilda carries the meaning “Pure, Tender, Noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Casilda usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, tender, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reflecting purity and nobility, inspiring inner strength and resilience.
data.etymology: Casilda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Tender, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Casilda total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
